screen_config.rationale: The prior CP1-to-CP3 design contains only two manager-feedback transitions. execution_server exposes six ordered checkpoints, so this no-transfer-only run tests whether a longer, treatment-feasible sequence retains score and action headroom before any recursive manager output is observed.

candidates.reason: Six-checkpoint workflow with observed explicit no-transfer completion at checkpoints 1, 2, and 3 and no prior treatment outcomes.

prefix_selection_rule.select: Choose the longest prefix k for which every checkpoint 1 through k has no infrastructure failure, checkpoints 1 through k-1 explicitly complete before action 32, checkpoint k explicitly completes before action 32, and checkpoint k normalized Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50.
prefix_selection_rule.headroom: The terminal checkpoint must fail at least one collected test or one Core test; a perfect terminal checkpoint is retained only as an engineering result and is not used for the primary degradation contrast.
prefix_selection_rule.fallback: If no prefix in 4, 5, or 6 qualifies, retain the already calibrated CP1-to-CP3 sequence rather than changing its action budget.

formal_if_valid.replication_policy: If the longer pilot has negative treatment-control gaps at both of its final two checkpoints, add two identical independent replicates. Otherwise do not increase depth again on this task.
